faq.q: What is the Cekat.AI customer service solution?
faq.a: One inbox for every chat channel, an AI agent answering repeat questions 24/7, a ticketing system, and a performance dashboard, all on the same platform.

faq.q: How does the AI know answers about our business?
faq.a: From the knowledge base you upload: product documents, return policies, price lists, or website pages. The AI answers only from those sources, and you can update them anytime.

faq.q: What if the AI does not know the answer?
faq.a: It does not make things up. Based on your rules, it either asks a clarifying question or hands over to a human agent with the full conversation history.

faq.q: Can the AI work only outside business hours?
faq.a: Yes. Set AI working hours: your team handles chats during office hours and the AI takes over after, the way Rumah Zakat runs it.
WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Telegram, and website live chat, all in the same inbox with one unified history.

faq.q: Can many agents share one WhatsApp number?
faq.a: Yes. Through the WhatsApp Business API, one number serves many agents at once with clean conversation assignment, no fighting over a phone.
Chat volume per channel and per hour, most frequent topics, response speed, and each agent's load, all on one dashboard.

faq.q: Can the AI answer in languages other than Indonesian?
faq.a: Yes. The AI replies in whatever language the customer writes in, so businesses serving customers across countries do not need a separate team per language.
